gloss: at its best for drinking; ready to drink

definitions.gloss: at its best for drinking; ready to drink; at the ideal drinking temperature or maturity
definitions.explanation: The optimal state for consuming a beverage, whether in terms of temperature, age (for wine), or brewing time (for tea). Often used for wine, sake, tea, and other drinks where timing or temperature matters.

examples.japanese: このワインは{今|いま}が{飲|の}み{頃|ごろ}だ。
examples.english: This wine is at its best for drinking right now.

examples.japanese: コーヒーが{少|すこ}し{冷|さ}めて{飲|の}み{頃|ごろ}になった。
examples.english: The coffee cooled down a bit and is now at a good drinking temperature.

examples.japanese: この{日本酒|にほんしゅ}は{冷|ひ}やして{飲|の}むのが{飲|の}み{頃|ごろ}の{温度|おんど}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that this sake is at its ideal drinking temperature when served chilled.

notes:
Composed of the verb stem {飲|の}み (to drink) and the suffix {頃|ごろ} (suitable time, peak). Indicates the ideal moment to enjoy a beverage based on temperature, maturity, or freshness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲|の}み{頃|ごろ}の{温度|おんど}: ideal drinking temperature
- {飲|の}み{頃|ごろ}になる: to reach the right point for drinking
- {今|いま}が{飲|の}み{頃|ごろ}: now is the best time to drink it

USAGE:
- Wine: refers to the aging period where flavor peaks
- Tea: refers to the right steeping time and temperature
- Coffee: refers to having cooled enough from scalding hot
- Beer: refers to freshness or optimal serving temperature

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}: ready to eat — the same pattern for food
- {見|み}{頃|ごろ}: at its best for viewing — for flowers, scenery
